On Christmas day, detectives are called to a crime scene where they find a young woman bound, gagged and mutilated in a horrific manner; then the killer turns his sights on Homicide Detective Molly Daul.

title: Someone You Thought You Knew
description:
S02 E03 — Maine Murder Mystery
In Webster Plantation, Maine, Mike and Valerie Miller are found shot dead in their own home, and authorities must consider a list of suspects that includes their own family members.

title: Someone You Thought You Knew
description:
S02 E06 — Nightmare on Oak Hollow Drive
Etta Jean Westbrook is a longtime resident of a quiet suburb in Bryan, Texas; when she is found murdered inside her home, detectives question her loved ones and canvass the neighborhood in order to catch the killer.

title: Betrayed
description:
S04 E04 — Kiss of Death
Cindy Thompson, 27, reconnects with her high school sweetheart and gets pregnant with his child, but someone wants to snuff out the couple's happiness, and Cindy's life.

title: Betrayed
description:
S04 E01 — A Bitter Pill
Debbie Ashley is a pharmaceutical rep who hopes her third marriage to a respected hospital executive will be forever, but when her body turns up in the trunk of her car, a stunning confession bares dark secrets in Debbie's seemingly idyllic life.

title: Betrayed
description:
S04 E03 — Little Shop of Horrors
A 19-year-old aspiring architect, Claudette Ficik charms every young man she meets, from co-workers at the pet store to her classmates, but when her body turns up in an Atlanta-area river, a shocking secret is revealed -- she was pregnant.

title: Betrayed
description:
S04 E10 — The Body in the Cornfield
Barbara Keim is juggling two ex-husbands and a rebellious teenage daughter who has a questionable circle of friends; when Barbara goes missing, her sisters fear the worst.

title: Death by Fame
description:
S03 E04 — A Crime of Fashion
When a fashion designer is found dead at an exclusive members-only hotel, the police must investigate the crime and find the person behind it.

title: Death by Fame
description:
S03 E03 — Reality Bites
A small-town family strikes it rich when they find a natural gas pocket under their property; Hollywood comes knocking to give them their own show; when one of the family members shines brightly, not everyone wants her star to rise.

title: Death by Fame
description:
S03 E05 — G or Gent?
Baron Dirty Colon goes on the reality show "From G's to Gents," hoping to change his life and take home the $100,000 prize pot; but he's hiding a huge secret about his real motivation for wanting to join the competition show.

title: Death by Fame
description:
S03 E06 — Off the Deep End
Runway model turned "mom-a-ger" Samira Frasch lives a life of luxury and flamboyance, seemingly out of a fairytale; when she turns up dead at the bottom of her pool, police uncover a marriage filled with infidelities, accusations and deep motives.

title: People Magazine Investigates

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S09 E12 — Where is Judith?
A home intruder abducts a 60-year-old woman in the night; local sheriffs search relentlessly until they discover another horrifying attack just ten miles away that fits the same profile; is there a serial predator haunting Florida's Gulf Coast?

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S09 E01 — Vanished in the Heartland
Questions and accusations fly after savvy entrepreneur and mother of five, 52-year-old Dee Warner, vanishes from her rural Michigan home. Authorities struggle for answers, until one day they find her, closer to home than anyone could have imagined.

description:

Never-before-seen footage from O.J. Simpson's prank show reveals how a volatile comeback attempt unraveled; mounting tension, uneasy encounters, and behind-the-scenes truths test the ethical boundaries of America's media machine.

description:

A volatile production tracks O.J. Simpson as he performs pranks for a hidden camera show, exposing uneasy encounters, shifting moods, and a carefully crafted persona that begins to crack under pressure.

description:
S01 E04 — It Has Escapability
During week two of Juiced, the production captures O.J. Simpson's drunken descent as he revisits his past, blurring performance and reality while seeking validation; tensions peak when O.J.'s girlfriend shows up on set with mysterious bruises.

description:

In Jonesboro, Ark., authorities investigate the death of Steven McQuay after his badly beaten body turns up in the back of a pickup truck; when the results of the victim's toxicology report arrive, the entire investigation plunges into a tailspin.

title: The Murder Tapes
description:
S07 E01 — Three Loud Booms
In what looks like a planned ambush, a young man turns up dead in his garage in Maricopa, Ariz.; police must look into a romance gone wrong to find his killer, and the child that the two may share.

title: The Murder Tapes
description:
S07 E05 — Midnight on Autumn St.
A late-night shooting at an apartment complex in Hot Springs, Ark., leaves a young man dead in a bad drug deal and police question the person responsible for luring the victim to his death.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S17 E02 — My First Love Hunted People
When Christina meets Loren, she's looking for love and an escape from a troubled home; after his dark side emerges, Christina thinks she's the lone target of his rage; a trail of clues reveals that Loren and his best friend are serial killers.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S16 E02 — Our Little Sister, the Monster
Little sister Heather terrorizes her siblings, David and Crystal from a young age; everyone hopes she'll change when she becomes a mom, but she only gets worse; after Heather meets Kareem, she becomes a monster.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S16 E03 — They Stole My Childhood
Abby's life takes a dark turn when her aunt and uncle adopt her; what she initially hoped would be a blessing, turns into a nightmare as she realizes she's living with predators; escaping their clutches will take every ounce of her courage.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S16 E01 — He Saved Her Life, Then Took It
Betty hopes her sister's son, Chance, is a beacon of hope in their troubled lives, but Betty sees his dark side early on; he lacks empathy and becomes violent until he explodes in a fit of rage, harming the one person who cared for him most.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:

When Ryan's mother marries Blaine Nelson, he hopes he'll gain a fun-loving stepdad; instead, he gets chaos, pain and fear, and while Blaine relishes tormenting Ryan, he can never imagine just how dark and sadistic his stepfather truly is.

title: Signs of a Psychopath

Jenn Holman fell hard for Jesse Winnick: magnetic, dangerous and impossible to leave; after months of violence, exploitation and narrow escapes, one chilling phone call reveals how close she comes to becoming his next victim.

After 30-year-old single mother Kaye Robinson turns a stranger away from her door late at night, she has no idea that the threat to her family is far from over; with her young son in the home, Kaye will do everything in her power to keep him safe.

title: The 1980s: The Deadliest Decade
description:
S01 E01 — The Yuppie Murder
In Boston, Carol Stuart and her unborn child are shot dead, while her husband, Charles, survives the shooting to describe their black assailant and inflame racial tensions, then a witness comes forward with a story that blows open the case.

title: The 1980s: The Deadliest Decade
description:
S01 E02 — The Preppy Murder
Teenager Jennifer Levin is found strangled to death in Central Park, and a prep school heartthrob, Robert Chambers, is arrested for the crime; the press seizes on Chambers' claim that Levin's death happened during rough sex.

title: The 1980s: The Deadliest Decade
description:
S01 E04 — The Heartland Massacre
An entire family is wiped out in a mass murder, stunning a small town in Missouri; at first, the unlikely suspect is a 14-year-old boy, but the truth turns out to be even more shocking.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S03 E13 — The Sound of Silence
Gallaudet University is the premier college for the deaf in the United States, but this haven of higher learning is turned upside down after two students are murdered in their dormitory rooms.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S03 E09 — Murder on Newberry St.
In York, Pa., race riots claim the lives of an African-American mother and a young, white police officer; their deaths are largely forgotten until 30 years later when their cold cases are reopened, revealing the city's dark past.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S03 E08 — Fatal Family Secrets
A celebratory night turns deadly for the Whitaker family as they are gunned down at home; when investigators uncover a conspiracy, it will test one man's ability to forgive as he fights to save the criminal mastermind from the death penalty.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S03 E06 — Murder Among Friends
In the summer of 1980, a popular teen goes for a run around her hometown in Maine and, days later, her savagely beaten body is found; what happened remains a mystery for years until her mother intervenes and forces police to re-examine the case.

title: Betrayed
description:
S04 E07 — Unholy Alliances
Church secretary Dorothy "Dot" Finelli, 59, goes missing and turns up dead; police explore if she has been killed by a jealous new internet date or somebody she's known for years within her own family circle.

title: Betrayed
description:
S04 E09 — The Predator of Pleasant View
Suzy Goulart, 23, is just getting by like everybody else in the scrappy Pleasant View apartment complex, where little dramas between friends and lovers add up to Suzy's murder.

title: Betrayed
description:
S04 E02 — Killing With Kindness
Kind-hearted cashier Elizabeth Grosskopf scoops up human strays like puppies until one who wants more than just food and shelter kills her.

title: Obsession: Dark Desires
description:
S05 E06 — Can't Let Go
Eighteen-year-old Misty's parents warn her against becoming involved with a man who is nearly 15 years her senior, but no one realizes that Misty is actually in horrible danger.

title: Obsession: Dark Desires
description:
S05 E03 — Friend Request
When single mother Rosita accepts a stranger's friend request, she has no idea he's hiding a terrifying secret that will lead to a deadly game of cat and mouse.

title: Obsession: Dark Desires
description:
S05 E04 — Cabin in the Woods
Sandra never expected such extreme reprisals from her onetime partner, Norman, but when her daughter gets caught in the crosshairs, no one can predict how far Norman will go.

title: Obsession: Dark Desires
description:
S05 E02 — The Stalker's Imagination
After Katerina leaves her husband, and he fights back in imaginative ways to cause her pain, including getting her locked up for a crime she didn't commit, Katerina must do the unthinkable if she wants to escape forever.

title: Fatal Vows
description:
S07 E04 — Hell on Wheels
Charlene attracts more than one man with her beauty and one by one they all go crazy vying for her love; love may be heavenly, but for some it can be hell.

title: Married to Evil
description:
S01 E03 — The Devil of Denver
When Stacy Malman and Robert Feldman fall in love, it's a dream come true; behind closed doors, life becomes a living hell; one night, a knock at the door forces the couple to confront the truth and triggers a series of events ending in horror.

title: Married to Evil
description: Gripping true stories explore the wickedness behind the wedding and show the devastating consequences of what happens when people are betrayed by those who should love them the most.

A Christian couple open up their home to a young woman who needs help; however, their act of charity has unexpected consequences when emotional support gives way to physical attraction, and a lustful affair turns deadly.

title: The Night That Didn't End
description:
S01 E01 — Night on the Parkway
Billy Carter raises daughters Crystal and Misty in the Great Smoky Mountains of North Carolina; after a body is found on the scenic Blue Ridge Parkway, this family's piece of paradise becomes a nightmare they relive again and again.

title: The Night That Didn't End
description:
S01 E03 — Murder on the Reservation
On the Northern Cheyenne Indian Reservation, a young mother goes missing after the Fourth of July; when her body is discovered in the woods, the victim's family dig through the memories of their loved one to provide investigators with critical clues.

title: The Night That Didn't End
description:
S01 E05 — Murder in the Wetlands
In the coastal town of Leland, N.C., a missing woman is found dead in a swamp; as detectives speak with the victim's friends and family, they begin to unravel the truth behind a horrifying murder.
